retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, ink-style illustration featuring silhouetted figures destroying objects with a vibrant color gradient emerging from the wreckage against a distressed, off-white background.
triggerTerms: stark black silhouettes with magenta gradient
shattered electronics with birds flying out
distressed paper texture with ink blots
excludeWhen: clean minimalist vector art is required
soft pastel color palettes are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, graphic composition utilizing heavy black ink silhouettes and splatters. Two figures are depicted in the act of smashing television sets, with one figure standing and one crouching. From the point of impact, a swarm of birds erupts, transitioning from solid black into a vibrant magenta and purple gradient. The entire scene is set against a heavily textured, off-white background featuring subtle ink drips and bird silhouettes in the distance.
coreVisualRelationships: High contrast between black silhouettes and light textured background
Dynamic movement from the central impact point radiating outwards
Color transition from monochromatic black to saturated magenta/purple
Juxtaposition of destructive action with the organic flight of birds
coreInvariants: Heavy black ink-wash aesthetic with visible splatter and drip details
Magenta-to-purple gradient applied only to the 'energy' or 'debris' elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two central figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, scaled to dominate the horizontal center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pile of smashed televisions at the bottom center serves as the primary anchor point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the downward strike of the bats toward the impact zone, then follows the upward and rightward trajectory of the birds.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space at the top and sides, filled with light texture and small bird silhouettes to maintain balance.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast between black and white, with high saturation in the small accent areas.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white/cream, and a specific magenta-purple range

letterConstructionRules: Ornate, swirling flourishes on capital letters
Variable line weight with high contrast
characterSpecificRedesigns: T, D, and G feature extended calligraphic tails
Roman numerals are rendered as simple vertical bars with distressed edges
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, expressive lettering paired with a clean, spaced-out serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ornate, gothic feel of the primary lettering
Matches the wide-tracked, all-caps serif subtitle

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast ink illustration on a distressed cream paper background. Show two silhouetted men smashing old TVs with bats. Include ink splatters and a swarm of birds flying out from the impact, with the birds transitioning into a magenta and purple gradient.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom gothic-style lettering in the top left and a wide-tracked all-caps serif in the top right, both in solid black.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visible and distressed?
Do the birds feature a smooth magenta-to-purple gradient?
Are the silhouettes solid black with sharp, ink-like edges?
Is the typography positioned at the top, clear of the main illustration?

mustAchieve: Sense of kinetic energy and destruction
avoid: Bright, cheerful colors outside the specific accent

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast black and white balance
Ensure the gradient is limited to the birds/debris
Verify the background has a paper-like texture
Confirm the figures are rendered as silhouettes
Check that the ink splatters look organic and not repetitive
recipe.reuseFormula: Ink Silhouette + Destructive Action + Organic Emergence (Birds) + Single Accent Gradient + Distressed Paper Texture
